title: EG Oxidation Machine
description: Oxidation Machine adds the Oxidizer, a machine block that accelerates copper oxidation using Forge Energy (FE).
body:
**Oxidation Machine** adds the **Oxidizer**, a machine block that accelerates copper oxidation using Forge Energy (FE). Instead of waiting for natural oxidation, players can process copper blocks directly with an efficient powered alternative.

The Oxidizer supports waxed and unwaxed copper block variants and uses **stage chips** to control the target oxidation stage. It also supports waxing with vanilla honeycombs, with planned support for custom oil-tagged items in the future.

The machine works with hoppers and item pipes, and has been tested with ATM10.

If you run into any issues, please report them on my Discord or GitHub.
